tei:div.tei:p: phyag rgya bzhi'i zur 'debs kyi thog mar dam rgya ni/ lha rnams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su thog mtha' med pa'i chos nyid kyi ngo bo dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i mtshan par gyur/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ badzra dṛṣṭi ma ṭa/ oṃ sarba bid dṛ shya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a haṃ/ sarba bid/ zhes snying po lan gsum dang*/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gtso bo'i sngags lan gsum brjod/ de bzhin du/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ badzra dṛṣṭi ma ṭa/ oṃ sarba bid dṛshya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a haṃ/ sarba bid/ ces lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod| sa ma ya st+waṃ/ badzra dṛṣṭi ma ṭa/ oṃ sarba bid dṛshya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a haṃ/ sarba bid/ ces lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ ces lan gsum/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ badzra dṛṣṭi ma ṭa/ oṃ sarba bid dṛshya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a haṃ/ sarba bid/ ces lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ zhes lan gsum/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ badzra dṛṣṭi ma ṭa/ oṃ sarba bid dṛshya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a haṃ/ sarba bid/ ces lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ ces lan gsum/ de bzhin du/ ༈ su ra te st+waṃ/ badzra dṛṣṭi ma ṭa/ buddha lo tsa ni dṛshya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a haṃ/ buddha lo tsa ni/ zhes lan gsum/ oṃ buddha lo tsa ni hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum/ su ra te st+waṃ/ badzra dṛṣṭi ma ṭa/ badzra mā ma kī dṛshya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a haṃ/ badzra mā ma kī/ zhes lan gsum/ oṃ badzra mā ma kī trāṃ/ zhes lan gsum/ de bzhin du kun la snying po'i sngags so so la sbyar nas rig 'gre'o// badzra pāṇḍa ri/ oṃ badzra pāṇḍa ri hrīḥ badzra tā re/ oṃ badzra tā re āḥ de bzhin du/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badzra rā dza dzaḥ oṃ badzra rā ga hoḥ

oṃ badzra sā dhu dhu/ oṃ badzra ratna trāṃ/ oṃ badzra te dza rya/ oṃ badzra ke tu bhri/ oṃ badzra hā sa hā/ oṃ badzra dharma hrīḥ oṃ badzra tīkṣa ṇa dhīḥ oṃ badzra he tu kruṃ/ oṃ badzra bhā ṣa bhā/ oṃ badzra karma kaṃ/ oṃ badzra rakṣa raṃ/ oṃ badzra yakṣa kṣaṃ/ oṃ badzra sandhi ṣṭaṃ/ oṃ badzra lā sye hūm̐/ oṃ badzra mā le trāṃ/ oṃ badzra gī ti hrīḥ oṃ badzra nṛtye āḥ oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe trāṃ/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ghaṇṭa hoḥ ༈ kalpa bha dra/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra pa ri sho dha na dharma te ga ga na sa mudga te ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ ༈ /shra wa ka /rtsa rig brjod/ pra tyeka /rtsa rig brjod/ su ra ta st+waṃ/ badzra dṛṣṭi ma ṭa/ badzra kro dha dṛshya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a haṃ/ badzra kro dha/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ rtsa rig lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa chos rgya ni/ lha thams cad kyi lkog mar hrīḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa mdun gyi 'dab ma gcig lcer gyur pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa chur nyal ba/ rdo rje'i lte bar lha rang rang gi sngags kyis mtshan par gyur par dmigs te/ oṃ badzra dzi hwā/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ oṃ buddha lo tsa ni hūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badzra ghaṇṭa hoḥ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra sogs/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa las rgya ni/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan par gyur par bsams la/ gar dang glu dang ro dang zas// spyod lam la sogs bde ba rnams// sangs rgyas rnams la phul nas ni// las kyi phyag rgyas dbang du 'gyur// sarba bid/

sarba bid/ sarba bid/ sarba bid/ sarba bid/ buddha lo tsa ni/ zhes pa nas/ badzra kro dha/ zhes pa'i bar du brjod/ bzhi pa phyag chen ni/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du thog ma'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur/ sarba bid/ sogs nas/ badzra kro dha'i bar gong ltar brjod nas/ oṃ buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ padma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de ltar dbang bskur bas rigs lnga'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ de nas phrin las bcol ba ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shuddhe bi shuddhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ ces dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ sbyong ba'i rgyal po dang*/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ rgyal mchog rin chen dang*/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ shākya ri dbang dang*/ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ me tog cher rgyas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te rtsa rig kun la 'gre'o/ oṃ buddha lo tsa ni hūm̐/ sangs rgyas spyan ma dang*/ oṃ badzra mā ma kī trāṃ/ rdo rje mā ma kī dang*/ oṃ badzra pāṇḍa ri hrīḥ gos dkar mo dang*/ oṃ badzra tā re āḥ sgrol ma ste/ yum bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/

oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ oṃ badzra rā dza dzaḥ rdo rje rgyal po dang*/ oṃ badzra rā ga hoḥ rdo rje chags pa dang*/ oṃ badzra sā dhu dhu/ rdo rje legs pa ste/ shar phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ badzra ratna trāṃ/ rdo rje rin chen dang*/ oṃ badzra te dza rya/ rdo rje gzi brjid dang*/ oṃ badzra ke tu bhri/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*/ oṃ badzra hā sa hā/ rdo rje bzhad pa ste/ lho phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ badzra dharma hrīḥ rdo rje chos dang*/ oṃ badzra tīkṣa ṇa dhīḥ rdo rje rnon po dang*/ oṃ badzra he tu kruṃ/ rdo rje rgyu dang*/ oṃ badzra bhā ṣa bhā/ rdo rje smra ba ste/ nub phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya| tadya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shuddhe bi shuddhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ oṃ badzra karma kaṃ/ rdo rje las dang*/ oṃ badzra rakṣa raṃ/ rdo rje srung ba dang*| oṃ badzra yakṣa kṣaṃ/ rdo rje gnod sbyin dang*/ oṃ badzra sandhiṣṭaṃ/ rdo rje khu tshur te/ byang phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/

oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ badzra lā sye hūm̐/ sgeg mo ma dang*/ oṃ badzra mā le trāṃ/ rdo rje phreng ba ma dang*/ oṃ badzra gī ti hrīḥ glu ma dang*/ oṃ badzra nṛtye āḥ gar ma ste/ nang gi sgeg mo bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ bdug spos ma dang*/ oṃ badzra puṣpe trāṃ/ me tog ma dang*/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ snang gsal ma dang*/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥ dri chab ma ste/ phyi yi sgeg mo bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shuddhe bi shuddhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ rdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ rdo rje lcags sgrog dang*/ oṃ badzra ghaṇṭa hoḥ rdo rje 'bebs pa ste/ sgo ma bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra pa ri shuddha dharma te ga ga na sa mudga te ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan mun 'joms/ spos kyi glang po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog /'od dpag med/ zla 'od/ bzang skyong*/ dra ba can/ rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ kun tu bzang po ste/ bskal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug gis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/

oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shuddhe bi shuddhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ dga' bo/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ shā ri'i bu/ maudgal gyi bu/ rab 'byor/ 'char ka /ma 'gags pa/ kauṇḍi n+ya/ nye bar 'khor/ rta thul/ ba lang bdag /kun dga' bo/ ming chen/ nor 'dzin/ gang po/ 'od srung ste/ nyan thos chen po bcu drug gis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol| oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ gdung ba sel ba/ snang ba brtsegs pa/ dpa' bo 'dul ba/ shes rab mgyogs chen/ smra ba'i sgra gcan/ bse ru lta bu/ rdzu 'phrul cher ston| seng ge sgra/ 'jigs pa med pa/ ri bo rgyal/ dug chen 'joms pa/ yid myur ba ste/ rang rgyal chen po bcu gnyis kyis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya| tadya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shuddhe bi shuddhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes dang*/ khro bo bzhi/ bran bzhi/ pho nya bzhi/ mngags pa bzhi| khro tshogs chen po bcu drug gis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes so// //gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs thung ni/ oṃ na ma st+rai ya dhi' kā nāṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya garbahe dzwa la dzwa la/ dharma dhā tu garbahe/ saṃ ha ra ma ma ā yu saṃ sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa mantoṣṇī ṣa bi ma le bi shuddhe hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/
